title: A city's solid waste, from generation to controlled facilities (invented)
about: An invented city of 100,000 households (Ardel, as in the programmes cohort) accounted for after the seven steps of UN-Habitat's Waste Wise Cities Tool: ninety households in three income strata and nine areas weighed for a week, markets, commerce and institutions declared, a materials recovery facility and a composting site sending their residues to a landfill, a dumpsite, and a ladder of control whose criteria each facility meets or not; SDG 11.6.1 with the survey's interval. Every household, amount, facility and criterion is invented to show the tool and says so; the ladder's five names are WaCT's, its criteria placeholders.
